headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture, and the selectors and list paths the builder derived (each has its reason in the builder's card); the Popular / Latest button names, tabs, filters and settings from "Lists and options" (empty lists when none were recorded).

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: The popular list path with {page} filled, one ITEM card per title: TITLE for the name and link, COVER for the picture through COVER_ATTR.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The latest list path, the same cards (the popular path again when the site has no separate list).

search.title: Search
search.text: The search path with the words and page filled (the address recorded from a real search on the site when there is one), the same cards; each filter's value is added to the address as param=value, empty ones left out.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: The h1 or og:title, og:image as cover, the meta description and genre-looking links: what every site prints, until a tap says otherwise.

getChapterList.title: Chapters / episodes
getChapterList.text: The CHAPTER links of the title page, each address once, the last number in the text as the number, the picked date element when there is one. When the title page is the only episode (SINGLE_EPISODE), that page is episode 1 with the picked date / number read on it. With no chapter link picked the part is not written, and a JSON build is written as JS (the JSON format can't say why there are no chapters; the JS one throws "No chapter link was picked…").

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: The IMAGE pictures of the chapter page, the address from IMAGE_ATTR then the lazy-load attributes and src.

getVideoList.title: Videos
getVideoList.text: The app's video finder (host.findVideo) opens the episode page in the hidden browser, presses Play and catches the stream the player asks for (.m3u8 / .mpd / .mp4), also when the site's script fills in the player's address; then it opens the player itself with the page as Referer. HLS is split into qualities; the quality / server settings put the preferred ones first. Nothing caught: the error says why (no player, never asked for a video, streams in pieces, page didn't load).

extras.title: Tabs, filters and settings
extras.text: Added only when "Lists and options" recorded some: tabs become buttons at the top of Browse (getCatalogs / getCatalog with the same cards), filters the filter sheet (search adds their values), settings the source's settings (read with host.preference.get("key")).

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the list path with {page} / {q} filled, a parameter set in an address, the shared card parser (titles with a hidden word left out when the source has that setting), absolute addresses and the last number of a text.

3.note: Videos use the app's video finder: plays players whose address the site's script fills in and catches DASH.
